chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله pray the Ẓuhr prayer at Minā on the Day of Tarwiyah
He said: "Yes, and also the morning prayer on the Day of ʿArafah."

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the one answering the question.
key_terms.الظُّهْرَ: The Ẓuhr salat (prayer), the noon prayer.
key_terms.الْغَدَاةَ: The morning prayer, referring here to Fajr.
key_terms.بِمِنًى: At Minā, the hajj location where the prayer was performed.
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, whose practice is being asked about.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ: A prominent narrator who asks the Imam about the ruling and practice.
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: The Day of Tarwiyah, the eighth day of Dhū al-Ḥijjah.
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: The Day of ʿArafah, the ninth day of Dhū al-Ḥijjah.

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله pray Ẓuhr at Minā on the Day of Tarwiyah?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله during hajj. It indicates that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله performed the Ẓuhr prayer at Minā on the Day of Tarwiyah and also remained there through the morning prayer on the Day of ʿArafah, showing an aspect of the Prophetic sunnah related to the rites and timing of hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2977 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Abu Ja'far (as):
"Did the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) pray the Zuhr prayer in Mina on the Day of Tarwiyah?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes, and also the Fajr prayer on the Day of Arafah."
